# FullEnrich

FullEnrich is a B2B email and phone waterfall enrichment platform that aggregates contact information from over 15 premium vendors to find the emails and phone numbers of leads.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/fullenrich/.

## Actions

- **Get Bulk Enrichment Result** (read-only): Retrieve results of a bulk enrichment by enrichment ID.
- **Get current credit balance** (read-only): Retrieve current workspace credit balance.
- **Start Bulk Enrichment**: Start a bulk enrichment job.
- **Create Contact Data List**: Create a list of contact data entries.
